name: blur-vignette
title: Blur Vignette
description: A square container whose outer edges blur and fade into the background, leaving the middle crisp. The demo pairs a dark text panel with a mountain photo to show the effect on copy and imagery.
use: You want to soften where a photo or card meets the page without a hard border or heavy shadow.
avoid: Backdrop blur costs GPU, and the fade hides edge content such as captions or buttons.
a11y: Purely visual effect with nothing to operate; it has no motion but also no accessibility hooks. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two rounded squares side by side on a near-black page: one a dark grey panel of small white text, the other a photo of snowy mountains above a sea of cloud at dusk. On both, a band around the border softens and dissolves into the page while the centre stays clear.
behaves: Static: the blur mask is painted once and neither animates nor responds to the pointer. The blur amount, inset and fade length are fixed by props rather than interaction.
customise: Radius, inset, transition length and blur are props on the wrapper, while classname sets size and background. Children sit beneath a separate article layer that carries the mask.
weight: light: One backdrop-blur layer with a CSS mask and no script beyond React.
